tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search tracked Amazon UK listings for CPUs, GPUs, RAM, motherboards and storage. Prices are in pence. Returns up to 10 results with current price, stock state, a product URL and buyUrl. Use this to answer "what does X cost" and "what is the cheapest Y". Give the user buyUrl when they want to buy: ne

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch one tracked product by its numeric ID: name, brand, current price in pence, stock state and rating. buyUrl is the link to give a user who wants to buy it; never rebuild an Amazon link from the ASIN. IDs come from search_products.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Recorded price points for a product over a trailing window, with minimum, maximum, average and the direction of travel. Use this to answer "is now a good time to buy" and "has this got cheaper".

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Index of published articles on UK component pricing and buying advice, most recent first.

tools.name: get_price_verdict
tools.description: Answer whether a tracked product is cheap right now, by its own recorded history rather than against other products. tools.name: get_best_value
tools.description: Rank tracked storage by price per terabyte (unit "tb") or memory by price per gigabyte (unit "gb"), cheapest first. Unit prices are in pence. tools.name: get_price_index
tools.description: Month-by-month price movement for a category of UK components, base 100 at the start of the series. Use to answer whether prices in a category are rising or falling. This describes a category, not an individual product: for one product use get_price_verdict. lastComputedAt says how fresh the answer
